sentences.en: Sami was known for his unpredictability and aggressiveness.
sentences.zh: 萨米以不可预测和好斗著称。

sentences.en: He has none of his father's aggressiveness.
sentences.zh: 他一点也不像他父亲那样好斗。

sentences.en: Everyone knows the separatists for their aggressiveness.
sentences.zh: 所有人都知道这些分离主义者以好斗著称。

senses.zh: 侵略性，攻击性；积极性，进取心
